csv_project_name: AE for Brooklyn Navy Yard Barge Basin Rehabilitation
csv_scope_of_work: The Brooklyn Navy Yard Development Corporation ( BNYDC ) is issuing this Request for Proposals ( RFP ) to seek proposals ( Proposals ) from entities ( Respondents ) experienced and interested in performing design and engineering services, including site investigations and evaluations, and construction support services in connection with the rehabilitation of marine structures at the Barge Basin (the Project ) within the Brooklyn Navy Yard (the Services ). A Respondent will be selected to perform all design, engineering, and construction support related tasks associated with the rehabilitation of marine structures at the Barge Basin, associated shoreline improvements, incidental site and utility improvements necessary for marine structure work.
csv_disciplines_requested: Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Site Evaluation/Selection
